scope: John 1-12 (39 entries), with a whole-Gospel synthesis across all 68

reviewer_self_correction: The prediction note was read correctly this time, including the retraction inside it. The earlier John pass called that note fully validated without registering that half of it had been withdrawn — C11 quotes John 1:14 in its own text, so John was always going to close it. This pass states the half-a-test qualification in its own words and identifies John 15:1-8 as the genuine structural anchor. A reviewer catching its own prior miss is worth recording alongside the ones it caught in the drafter.
note: First book reviewed in two passes and cleared in both.
